messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert triggered: PD#INC-7742 — edge-lb-targets unhealthy (TLS handshake failures). Auto-escalation in 90s if not acknowledged. https://pagerduty.example/INC-7742

pagerduty: Alert details:
- symptom: 5xx / TLS alert (handshake_failure) from edge -> backend
- metric: edge-proxy tls_fail_rate spike from 0.1% -> 3.8% across eu-west-1
- routed services: /generate, /chat-stream, frontend-edge

maria (oncall_sre): Acked. looking. assigning to network for target health check.

kyle_neteng: I can take this. seeing target group for eu-west-1 with several targets Unhealthy. Pulling describe-target-health now.

kyle_neteng: ```
$ aws elbv2 describe-target-health --target-group-arn arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:eu-west-1:123456:targetgroup/edge-tg/abcdef
{
  "TargetHealthDescriptions": [
    {"Target": {"Id": "i-0a1b2c3d4e5f6"}, "TargetHealth": {"State": "unhealthy", "Reason": "TLS_HANDSHAKE_FAILURE"}},
    {"Target": {"Id": "i-0b1c2d3e4f5g6"}, "TargetHealth": {"State": "unhealthy", "Reason": "TIMEOUT"}},
    {"Target": {"Id": "i-0c1d2e3f4g5h6"}, "TargetHealth": {"State": "healthy"}}
  ]
}
```

maria (oncall_sre): Confirmed. TLS handshake failures on two targets. Any recent deploys or cert rotations in eu-west-1? ops-runbook-bot, check recent cert job history.

ops-runbook-bot: Found rollout: "edge-cert-rotation-2026-03-14-23:02" completed ~20m ago in eu-west-1. No rollback recorded.

kyle_neteng: Hm. That aligns with the start of the spike. Rolling cert rotation back on a single host to validate. Will cordon one unhealthy target and re-register a known-good instance.

maria (oncall_sre): Runbook step: if TLS_HANDSHAKE_FAILURE after cert rotation, rollback rotation for affected host group and shift LB weights to healthy AZ temporarily. Also throttle DNS updates.

kyle_neteng: Doing a targeted drain + deregister for i-0a1b2c3d4e5f6:
```bash
aws elbv2 deregister-targets --target-group-arn arn:... --targets Id=i-0a1b2c3d4e5f6
```

kyle_neteng: Re-registered fallback instance i-0f1e2d3c4b5a6 which has last-known-good cert. Shifting weights:
```bash
# quick weight shift to healthy pool (partial)
aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id ZZZZ --change-batch '{"Changes":[{"Action":"UPSERT","ResourceRecordSet":{"Name":"edge.example.redwood.ai","Type":"A","SetIdentifier":"eu-west-healthy","Weight":80,"ResourceRecords":[{"Value":"54.12.34.56"}]}}]}'
```

leo_support: Noted. CS: multiple EU customers reporting increased error rates for generation endpoints, some timeouts in dashboard. Collecting list of affected orgs and severity.

jenna_prod_mgmt: How big is the customer impact? SLA risk?

maria (oncall_sre): Current 5xx rate for /generate = 4.2% globally, EU region 9.1%. Hitting some PLG customers (dev sandbox calls) and a handful of paying customers experiencing elevated latency/timeouts. Logging contact list to PD incident.

kyle_neteng: After weight shift and draining two unhealthy targets, TLS errors down from 3.8% -> 0.8% in last 2 mins. Rolling for next 10m to confirm stability.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: PagerDuty INC-7742 acknowledged by maria (oncall_sre) at 6790004340 — auto-escalation stopped.

maria (oncall_sre): Next steps: 1) hold weight shift for 30m; 2) rollback cert rotation on affected ASG if we confirm correlation; 3) open a post-incident to track RCA and cert process changes. I'll escalate to infra for the cert rollback approval.

kyle_neteng: Evidence collected: cert thumbprints mismatch vs known-good. I'll prepare rollback patch for cert-manager job and coordinate with infra.

ops-runbook-bot: Suggested command to rollback cert-manager job:
```bash
kubectl -n certs rollout undo deployment/cert-manager --to-revision=2
```

maria (oncall_sre): Do not run global rollback without infra signoff. We can rollback affected node-group ASG launch-configs first.

leo_support: CS: informing impacted customers with status updates: "We're experiencing transient TLS errors affecting API requests in eu-west-1. We've applied mitigations and are monitoring — ETA 30m." :email:

jenna_prod_mgmt: Please add any customer org IDs we need to escalate to account execs.

maria (oncall_sre): Will collate. For now mitigation holding. Monitoring key signals: tls_fail_rate, 5xx_rate, lb_target_unhealthy_count, tail latency. 

kyle_neteng: Observability note — we saw a DNS weight change + cert rotation job within same minute window. Both are suspects. I'll pause any further DNS weight ops.

incident-bot: PD note: escalation policy paused. Next automation check in 10m.

maria (oncall_sre): After 18 minutes of stability with weights shifted, I want a controlled rollback of cert rotation for the affected ASG. Infra: @kyle_neteng, can you queue a rollback and I'll approve?

kyle_neteng: Queued rollback to previous cert bundle for ASG edge-eu-1 at 6790004445. Rolling in batches of 2 instances.

ops-runbook-bot: Rollout status: batch 1 completed, all targets healthy. batch 2 in progress.

maria (oncall_sre): Good. 5xx rates back to baseline 0.2% in EU. tls_fail_rate down to 0.05%. Reverting weight shift after we confirm host health across all AZs.

kyle_neteng: Reverting Route53 weights back to original slowly (20% steps). 

leo_support: CS update sent to impacted customers (initial notice + now resolved mitigation).

jenna_prod_mgmt: Thanks. Let's schedule a follow-up postmortem and change the cert-rotation runbook to include pre-checks and canary windows.

maria (oncall_sre): Agreed. Handoff: I'm handing primary for next hour to kyle_neteng for cleanup and post-incident tasks. kyle, please take over, I'll update PD and close oncall ticket if stable.

kyle_neteng: Taking over. Leaving this thread open for 1h for any regressions. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: PagerDuty INC-7742 status: Mitigated. Acknowledged by kyle_neteng. Follow-up: P0 -> P1 for RCA.

leo_support: Closing customer-facing thread, marking impacted orgs: org-234, org-998, org-120.

maria (oncall_sre): Thanks team. Postmortem owner: kyle_neteng. will add timelines and signal graphs.

kyle_neteng: Logged RCA ticket #RCA-2026-03-14-22. I'll include Terraform/Cert-manager diffs and propose a safe canary workflow.

ops-runbook-bot: Note: add a pre-rotation checker to ensure rolling cert fingerprints are valid on a canary instance before global apply.

maria (oncall_sre): Closing incident channel updates. If you see any regressions, re-page PD and @maria.

jenna_prod_mgmt: :raised_hands: Great work everyone.
